description: Bus Ridership is a dataset listed in City of Mesa open data portal (citydata.mesaaz.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Mesa. NOTE: There are problems with data accuracy on bus ridership counts for June 2019, July 2019, and August 2019 as Phoenix and Valley Metro attempt to integrate new hardware with the existing system. For Mesa this is clearly impacting routes 156, 531, and 541, however, there are minor anomalies with some of the other routes. Coverage: Mesa, Arizona. The portal files it under the category Transit Services. Its tags are bus, ridership, route, valley metro, downtown. The table has 7 columns. Attribution on the portal: Transit Services. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-citydata-mesaaz-gov-portal.
